title: References document
description: External read-mostly research targets recorded by `researchlog references add`. Each entry points at a sibling project the cwd reads from; reconcile enforces presence and doc-anchors.

id.description: Stable id used by `references add` and by EV artifact URIs.

path.description: Absolute path to the target on disk. The workspace never copies the target's content; paths must remain valid for as long as the workspace exists.

purpose.description: How this target is used by the workspace: the primary study, a cross-check source, or a baseline of the workspace's own past work.

read_only.description: True iff the workspace never writes to this target. reconcile asserts this on every artifact reference.

doc_anchors.description: Relative paths inside the target that act as discoverable entry points.

size_gb.description: Approximate size of the target in GB; recorded for human readers, never validated.

invalidated_if.description: Predicate strings the target must keep satisfying for any EV depending on it to stay valid.
